query:
-- WV Senate: Rachel Fetty Anderson wins Democratic primary
UPDATE senate_races 
SET primary_winner = 'Rachel Fetty Anderson', 
    primary_party = 'Democrat',
    candidate1_name = 'Rachel Fetty Anderson',
    candidate1_party = 'Democrat',
    status = 'General'
WHERE state = 'West Virginia' AND office = 'U.S. Senate';

-- NE Senate: Confirm Cindy Burbank (D) and Pete Ricketts (R) - already set, just verify primaryWinner
UPDATE senate_races 
SET primary_winner = 'Cindy Burbank',
    primary_party = 'Democrat'
WHERE state = 'Nebraska' AND office = 'U.S. Senate';

-- NE Governor: Lynne Walz wins Democratic primary, Jim Pillen wins Republican primary
UPDATE governor_races
SET dem_candidate = 'Lynne Walz',
    primary_winner = 'Lynne Walz',
    primary_party = 'Democrat'
WHERE state = 'Nebraska';

-- NE-1: Chris Backemeyer wins Democratic primary, Mike Flood (R) uncontested
UPDATE house_races
SET primary_winner = 'Chris Backemeyer',
    primary_party = 'Democrat',
    candidate1_name = 'Chris Backemeyer',
    candidate1_party = 'Democrat',
    status = 'General'
WHERE state = 'Nebraska' AND district = 1;

-- NE-3: Adrian Smith wins Republican primary (D: Bill Stille uncontested)
UPDATE house_races
SET primary_winner = 'Adrian Smith',
    primary_party = 'Republican',
    candidate2_name = 'Adrian Smith',
    candidate2_party = 'Republican',
    status = 'General'
WHERE state = 'Nebraska' AND district = 3;

-- WV-1: Carol Miller (R) wins, WV-2: Riley Moore (R) wins
UPDATE house_races
SET primary_winner = 'Carol Miller',
    primary_party = 'Republican',
    candidate2_name = 'Carol Miller',
    candidate2_party = 'Republican',
    status = 'General'
WHERE state = 'West Virginia' AND district = 1;

UPDATE house_races
SET primary_winner = 'Riley Moore',
    primary_party = 'Republican',
    candidate2_name = 'Riley Moore',
    candidate2_party = 'Republican',
    status = 'General'
WHERE state = 'West Virginia' AND district = 2;
